actions.label: Look up the positive result, review the chart, open a work item
actions.source: assumed: 5 minutes; E11-1 'reading medical history/report' (14.0 minutes, complex-care coordinators) is the upper bound

actions.label: Acknowledge the result in the record
actions.source: assumed: no time study of result acknowledgement found

actions.label: Decide who follows the case up and hand it over (no named owner today)
actions.source: E11-1 'handover' 9.5 minutes (SD 4.1), 'prioritising patients' 10.3; care coordinators in a hospital-community service

actions.label: Phone the patient (one attempt, with documentation)
actions.source: E11-1 'follow-up call after discharge' 7.2 minutes (SD 3.5); E11-2: 15.5 minutes on calls over a typical 4 calls = 3.9 (low), 48.5 total per patient / 4 = 12.1 (high)

actions.label: Send the patient an SMS or WhatsApp message by hand
actions.source: assumed: 1.5 minutes; E11-5 assumed 1 minute per reminder call (the floor)

actions.label: Prepare and post a letter
actions.source: assumed: 4 minutes; E11-4 reports 17.5 minutes to compile and mail materials per woman over 18 months (number of mailings not reported)

actions.label: Send or fax the referral to the endoscopy service
actions.source: E11-1 'referral - external' 12.4 minutes (SD 9.1, n=102); E11-6 about 12 minutes per manual referral corroborates (secondary report)

actions.label: Record that the colonoscopy happened (find and file the report)
actions.source: assumed: 5 minutes

actions.label: Chase a patient who has not answered (phone call, up to N attempts)
actions.source: as M_PHONE_ATTEMPT: E11-1 follow-up call 7.2 minutes; E11-2 3.9 to 12.1 per call

actions.label: Chase the specialist's office that has not replied (up to N attempts)
actions.source: E11-1 'contracting/liaising with provider - external' 8.1 minutes (SD 11.7, n=192)

actions.label: Check whether an overdue colonoscopy happened (up to N attempts)
actions.source: assumed: 5 minutes

actions.label: Process a duplicate result from a second lab as a new work item
actions.source: assumed: same as M_RESULT_LOOKUP

actions.label: Clinician reads the colonoscopy report and documents the finding
actions.source: assumed: 5 minutes

actions.label: Clinician files the closure
actions.source: assumed: 3 minutes

actions.label: Record that the patient called back or walked in
actions.source: assumed: 2 minutes

actions.label: Book or rebook the colonoscopy appointment
actions.source: E11-4 'scheduling appointments and sending reminders' 8.0 minutes per woman; E11-3 'scheduling or rescheduling appointments' 15.1 minutes (high)

actions.label: Specialist reviews a referral and accepts or rejects it
actions.source: E11-1 'accepting/discussing referral' 9.5 minutes (SD 6.2, n=230); range is the mean plus or minus 1 SD (low halved)

actions.label: Clinician reviews a late finding that reopens a closed case
actions.source: assumed: 5 minutes

actions.label: Supervisor accepts an escalation
actions.source: assumed: 2 minutes to open the case, read the context and accept

actions.label: Coordinator accepts an escalation or a watchdog flag
actions.source: assumed: 2 minutes

actions.label: Supervisor phones the patient after an escalation
actions.source: as M_PHONE_ATTEMPT: E11-1 follow-up call 7.2 minutes; E11-2 3.9 to 12.1 per call

actions.label: Coordinator contacts the patient by the alternate route
actions.source: as M_PHONE_ATTEMPT: E11-1 follow-up call 7.2 minutes; E11-2 3.9 to 12.1 per call

actions.label: Approve a model-drafted message before it is sent
actions.source: assumed: 1.5 minutes. The simulator has no model drafts (every message is a pre-approved template), so one approval is charged on every human-contact message, the only non-template outreach

actions.label: Review the machine-prepared evidence and sign the closure
actions.source: assumed: 5 minutes (the clinician still reads the evidence the engine attached; 8 minutes = today's review plus filing)

actions.label: Handle an exhausted reroute list (find another service by hand)
actions.source: assumed: 15 minutes, about one external referral plus follow-up calls (E11-1 12.4 and 8.1)

actions.label: Review a case flagged lost (unreachable, declined, repeated no-show) and record the outcome
actions.source: assumed: 8 minutes

actions.label: Counsel a patient who declines and record the informed refusal (A33)
actions.source: assumed: 15 minutes for the conversation and the counselling record (the sign-off is charged as O_SIGN_CLOSURE)

actions.label: Review a consent withdrawal
actions.source: assumed: 5 minutes

actions.label: Find and record a corrected contact for an unreachable patient
actions.source: assumed: 5 minutes

actions.label: Receiving clinician decides on a transfer of the case after a provider switch
actions.source: assumed: 5 minutes; E11-1 'accepting/discussing referral' (9.5) is the upper bound

automated_steps.label: Case created from the result on ingest
Pre-approved template outreach, reminder and appointment reminder sent
Reminder rung emitted to the owner
Colonoscopy completion and its evidence detected
Appointment recorded from the unit's acceptance
Referral sent and rerouted down the provider list
Overdue raised at a missed SLA or appointment
Escalation, watchdog flag or lost-contact flag emitted
Patient's reply to a message detected
Conflicting ownership claim rejected by the state machine

never_done_in_baseline.work: Noticing a missed appointment and rebooking it
Overdue tracking against working-day SLAs and the escalation ladder
Noticing a rejected referral and rerouting it (only a share of rejections is noticed today)
Recording a consent withdrawal and stopping outreach
Merging duplicate results and resolving conflicting ownership claims
Surfacing a lost case to a human

parameters.notes: Completers only. Abu Dhabi 2015-2016: median 72 d (https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC8343888/). Kaiser 37 d (Corley), PROSPR 41-174 d, safety net 184 d (https://doi.org/10.1038/ajg.2016.555), AltaMed 94 d. Suggested parametric form: lognormal fitted to median and IQR (shape choice is an assumption). B18 check of the shape: Scotland (Public Health Scotland, OGL v3) 4- and 8-week shares fit a lognormal with median 39.9 d and sigma 0.63, and the reported median (40 d) was not used in the fit, so the lognormal form holds; the Scottish managed programme is faster (see time_to_colonoscopy_managed_ref_median_days). Kept at the Sea Mar value: the simulator compares its baseline arm (completer median about 61 d before B21, 48 d after the B21 timing mixture) to this target only in the report.

overrides.source: Capped at orchestration.contact_recovery_prob.owner (0.25): a supervisor's call recovers no more wrong contacts than the owner's re-contact.

Capped at orchestration.escalation_effect_prob.owner (0.50): no published evidence that escalating to a supervisor adds anything beyond re-contacting the owner (docs/evidence.md, Gaps).

overrides.notes: Upper-range value 1.0 (every case reached). Refitted 2026-10-18 from 0.50 to 0.55 after A18 milestones and A19 coalescing. B21 (timing mixture): NOT refitted. The anchor (pooled RR 1.27, J Gen Intern Med 2026) probably pools the Coronado 2021 Kaiser NW and 2025 Annals trials that docs/results/validation.md scores the ratio against, so refitting to it after a structural change would be circular; the literature-anchored 180-day ratio is reported where it lands (1.31, inside the pooled CI 1.10-1.46). Cases outside the reach are handled exactly as in the baseline arm (same random numbers), so they carry no owner, no timers, no escalation and can be lost silently.
overrides.source: Calibrated so the orchestrated/baseline completion ratio at 180 days equals navigation_effect = 1.27 (pooled RR 1.27, 95% CI 1.10-1.46, 8 navigation studies, moderate certainty, J Gen Intern Med 2026, PMID 42618855, https://doi.org/10.1007/s11606-026-10706-x; 12-month RCT: 55.1% vs 42.1%, Annals 2025, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC13007779/). Fit of 2026-10-18 (refit after A18 milestones and A19 coalescing): 0.55 gives a literature-anchored 180-day completion ratio of 1.272 (66.3% against 52.1%; 0.54 gives 1.268, 0.56 gives 1.276). Procedure and fitted ratios: docs/results/results.md.
Capped at patient_response.dropout_residual_multiplier (0.25): a human call does not re-engage a disengaged patient better than a digital re-contact.

overrides.notes: Upper-range value 0.167 (B18 fit, empirical, OpenML Medical Appointment No Shows; was 0.25 from Lam et al. 2021, relative reduction 11.9% -> 8.9%). At 0 the orchestrated arm's no-show is the no-reminder rate dna_rate (0.119) for every patient, which is above the baseline's 0.089 for SMS and phone patients (those baseline rates already embed Lam's SMS arm); the scenario therefore slightly understates orchestrated attendance for them. Left as is: we do not re-estimate the baseline.
overrides.source: Lower bound of the sensitivity range in docs/evidence.md section 4: Mahmud et al., JAMA Netw Open 2021 (753 patients, nine text messages, no effect on attendance with good prep, 53.1% vs 54.4%, P=.73). https://doi.org/10.1001/jamanetworkopen.2020.34553
